about.title: Associate Professor of Sustainable Materials & Technology
about.affiliation3: University of Maine, Orono, ME, USA
about.bio: The Zhang Lab at UMaine is dedicated to advancing innovative technologies that integrate biobased materials into additive manufacturing, develop biobased carbon (nano)materials for environmental remediation, synthesize biobased thermosets for adhesives and coatings, and apply cellulosic (nano)materials in sustainable packaging. With an interdisciplinary focus, our mission is to lead the development of technologies that not only minimize environmental impact but also foster ecosystem regeneration and drive the circular economy.
